diagnosed_gap.name: classification_profitability_misalignment
diagnosed_gap.cause: Retention, loss-removal, and Wilson gates count selected conditions but do not weight winners and losers by the recorded executable ask or entry fee.
diagnosed_gap.failure_mode: A high terminal win rate can pass every classification gate while buying winners so expensively that the selected payoff ratio remains below the existing A+ floor.
diagnosed_gap.test_profile: The frozen classification counts pass at a 0.90 selected ask, while fee-aware unit profit factor remains above 1.20 and payoff remains below 0.20; schema 4 rejects the block on payoff margin.

unit_economics_contract.pricing_basis: recorded decision-time ask for the selected direction
unit_economics_contract.entry_fee: polymarket_fee(shares, decision_ask, entry_fee_rate) using shares * fee_rate * price * (1 - price), rounded to five decimals
unit_economics_contract.ordering: condition open timestamp, then condition ID
unit_economics_contract.interpretation: This is an optimistic necessary screen at the recorded decision ask, not an executable replay or a profitability claim. Measured latency, depth traversal, fills, stateful sizing, breadth, and tails remain mandatory.

historical_sanity_envelope.interpretation: If winner and loss dollars were retained proportionally to the count gates, the classification minima would imply PF 1.433 and leave only 16.24% winner-dollar deterioration before PF falls below 1.20. Count retention does not guarantee dollar retention, so the explicit economic gates are required. This historical calculation does not score or tune the forward mechanism.

promotion_boundary.block_1_failure_action: reject the mechanism family without retuning
promotion_boundary.two_screen_passes_authorize: exactly one measured-latency runtime replay implementation
